Don't show this message again Close Print Up by 1.4% in the euro area and by 2.6% in the EU compared with August 2025 Overview In August 2026, compared with July 2026, seasonally adjusted production in construction increased by 1.8% in the euro area and by 2.0% in the EU , according to first estimates from Eurostat, the statistical office of the European Union . In July 2026, production in construction grew by 0.2% in the euro area and fell by 0.1% in the EU . In August 2026, compared with August 2025, production in construction increased by 1.4% in the euro area and by 2.6% in the EU . Monthly comparison by construction sector and by Member State In the euro area in August 2026, compared with July 2026, production in construction decreased by 0.4% for construction of buildings, decreased by 2.1% for civil engineering, increased by 2.5% for specialised construction activities. In the EU , production in construction decreased by 1.0% for construction of buildings, decreased by 0.2% for civil engineering, increased by 2.3% for specialised construction activities. Among Member States for which data are available, the highest monthly increases in production in construction were recorded in Hungary (+14.0%), Germany (+9.3%) and Romania (+7.2%). The largest decreases were observed in Slovenia (-5.1%), Slovakia (-4.9%) and Italy (-2.9%). Annual comparison by construction sector and by Member State In the euro area in August 2026, compared with August 2025, production in construction decreased by 3.7% for construction of buildings, remained stable for civil engineering, increased by 3.1% for specialised construction activities.
